what_it_does: This is a position paper that lays out the technological roadmap needed to scale AI systems from tiny edge devices (phones, sensors) all the way to massive cloud data centers. The paper identifies that AI is growing so fast that innovation in silicon, packaging (how chips are assembled together), system architecture, and software must happen in concert. Rather than proposing a single solution, it presents a matrix of enabling technologies across these layers: on the silicon side, better chip design and manufacturing processes; in packaging, new ways to combine multiple smaller chips into one unit and manage heat; in architecture, system-level optimizations; and in software and networking, support for training and inference at all scales. This is a framework-building paper meant to guide the industry's research priorities.
